mapper.sql: id, club_id, target_member_id, status, source_type, ban_reason, expires_at, banned_by_member_id, banned_at, unbanned_by_member_id, unbanned_at, unban_reason, ban_request_id, unban_request_id, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select b.id, b.club_id, b.target_member_id, b.status, b.source_type, b.ban_reason, b.expires_at, b.banned_by_member_id, b.banned_at, b.unbanned_by_member_id, b.unbanned_at, b.unban_reason, b.ban_request_id, b.unban_request_id, b.version, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, m.nickname as target_nickname, m.avatar as target_avatar from club_governance_ban b left join ums_member m on m.id = b.target_member_id where b.club_id = #{clubId} order by case when b.status = 'ACTIVE' then 0 else 1 end, b.banned_at desc, b.id desc
select from club_governance_ban where id = #{id} for update
select from club_governance_ban where club_id = #{clubId} and (ban_request_id = #{requestId} or unban_request_id = #{requestId}) limit 1 for update
select from club_governance_ban where club_id = #{clubId} and target_member_id = #{targetMemberId} and status = 'ACTIVE' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into club_governance_ban (club_id, target_member_id, status, source_type, ban_reason, expires_at, banned_by_member_id, banned_at, ban_request_id, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{clubId}, #{targetMemberId}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{banReason}, #{expiresAt}, #{bannedByMemberId}, #{bannedAt}, #{banRequestId}, #{version}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update club_governance_ban set status = 'UNBANNED', unbanned_by_member_id = #{unbannedByMemberId}, unbanned_at = now(), unban_reason = #{unbanReason}, unban_request_id = #{unbanRequestId}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and club_id = #{clubId} and status = 'ACTIVE' and version = #{expectedVersion} and source_type = 'CLUB'
mapper.select: select id, club_id, from_owner_member_id, to_owner_member_id, reason, request_id, transferred_at, create_time from club_governance_owner_transfer where club_id = #{clubId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into club_governance_owner_transfer (club_id, from_owner_member_id, to_owner_member_id, reason, request_id, transferred_at, create_time) values (#{clubId}, #{fromOwnerMemberId}, #{toOwnerMemberId}, #{reason}, #{requestId}, #{transferredAt}, #{createTime})

insert into club_member (club_id, member_id, role, status, join_time, del_flag) values (#{clubId}, #{memberId}, 0, 1, #{joinTime}, 0) on duplicate key update role = 0, status = 1, join_time = values(join_time), del_flag = 0
mapper.update: update club set member_id = #{newOwnerMemberId}, update_time = now() where id = #{clubId} and member_id = #{expectedOwnerMemberId} and status = 1 and del_flag = 0
